mapper.insert: /* com.portal.board.com.BBSUseInfoManageMapper.insertBBSUseInf */ INSERT INTO LETTNBBSUSE ( BBS_ID, TRGET_ID, REGIST_SE_CODE, USE_AT, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ) VALUES ( #{bbsId}, #{trgetId}, #{registSeCode}, #{useAt}, #{frstRegisterId}, SYSDATE() )
mapper.select:
/* com.portal.board.com.BBSUseInfoManageMapper.selectBBSUseInfsCnt */ SELECT COUNT(a.BBS_ID) FROM LETTNBBSUSE a LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTNBBSMASTER e ON a.BBS_ID = e.BBS_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE b ON b.CODE = a.REGIST_SE_CODE AND b.CODE_ID = 'COM001' WHERE a.REGIST_SE_CODE != 'REGC07'
AND e.BBS_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWrd}, '%')

/* com.portal.board.com.BBSUseInfoManageMapper.selectBBSUseInf */ SELECT a.BBS_ID, e.BBS_NM, a.TRGET_ID, a.REGIST_SE_CODE, b.CODE_NM AS REGIST_SE_CODE_NM, a.USE_AT, a.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '시스템 활용' AS CMMNTY_ID, '시스템 활용' AS CMMNTY_NM, '시스템 활용' AS CLB_ID, '시스템 활용' AS CLB_NM, '시스템 활용' AS BBS_TY_CODE FROM LETTNBBSUSE a LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTNBBSMASTER e ON a.BBS_ID = e.BBS_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE b ON b.CODE = a.REGIST_SE_CODE AND b.CODE_ID = 'COM001' WHERE a.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND a.TRGET_ID = #{trgetId}

/* com.portal.board.com.BBSUseInfoManageMapper.selectBBSUseInfsCntByTrget */ SELECT COUNT(tt.BBS_ID) FROM ( SELECT a.BBS_ID, d.USER_NM FROM LETTNBBSUSE a LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTNBBSMASTER b ON a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE c ON c.CODE = a.REGIST_SE_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER d ON a.TRGET_ID = d.ESNTL_ID WHERE a.BBS_ID IN ( SELECT BBS_ID FROM LETTNBBSUSE WHERE TRGET_ID = #{trgetId} AND USE_AT = 'Y' ) AND a.REGIST_SE_CODE = 'REGC07'
UNION ALL
SELECT a.BBS_ID, '[전체]' AS USER_NM FROM LETTNBBSUSE a LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTNBBSMASTER b ON a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE c ON c.CODE = a.REGIST_SE_CODE WHERE a.BBS_ID IN ( SELECT BBS_ID FROM LETTNBBSUSE WHERE TRGET_ID = #{trgetId} ) AND a.REGIST_SE_CODE IN ('REGC05', 'REGC06')
UNION ALL
SELECT a.BBS_ID, '' AS USER_NM FROM LETTNBBSUSE a LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTNBBSMASTER b ON a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE c ON c.CODE = a.REGIST_SE_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTNCMMNTYUSER e ON e.CMMNTY_ID = #{trgetId} LEFT OUTER JOIN LETTNCLUBUSER f ON f.CLB_ID = #{trgetId} LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER g ON e.EMPLYR_ID = g.ESNTL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER h ON f.EMPLYR_ID = h.ESNTL_ID WHERE a.BBS_ID IN ( SELECT BBS_ID FROM LETTNBBSUSE WHERE TRGET_ID = #{trgetId} AND USE_AT = 'Y' ) AND a.REGIST_SE_CODE IN ('REGC05', 'REGC06') AND ( (a.BBS_ID, e.EMPLYR_ID) NOT IN (SELECT BBS_ID, TRGET_ID FROM LETTNBBSUSE) OR (a.BBS_ID, f.EMPLYR_ID) NOT IN (SELECT BBS_ID, TRGET_ID FROM LETTNBBSUSE) ) ) tt
WHERE tt.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWrd}, '%')
